title: 成都的咖啡馆，就开在茶馆隔壁 | In Chengdu, Coffee Sits Next to the Teahouse ☕
description:
你去成都，先喝盖碗茶，还是先喝咖啡？

成都的咖啡馆，总爱开在老茶馆隔壁。这边一碗盖碗茶——盖为天、托为地、碗为人；那边一杯手冲咖啡。一个下午，两种杯子，同样的巴适慢生活。别小看这座喝茶的城：成都的咖啡馆数量全国第二，仅次于上海，2022 年就已经有近八千家。连喝了一辈子茶的老茶客，也点起了美式。在成都，喝啥不重要，巴适就行。

In Chengdu, the cafés love to sit right next to the old teahouses. A gaiwan of tea on one side, a pour-over on the other — one slow afternoon, two kinds of cups. This tea-drinking city quietly holds the second-most cafés in all of China, just behind Shanghai. Even lifelong tea-drinkers now order an Americano. Here, what you drink matters less than the feeling: 巴适 (bāshì) — easy, comfortable, just right.

川话彩蛋 / Sichuan dialect: 「巴适」— comfortable, nice, perfect; the word for Chengdu's easy slow life.

AI-assisted edit; footage licensed from Pexels (credited below). Subtitles are the narration — no voiceover.
